category: other: no retreat after the button press - pressed the start button, then stayed at the button face until timeout
what_happened: Scene: layout 8, black/silver capsule machine with two round buttons on a round front face, grey mug_9 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: grasped 142/156 and carried down; 300-580 it held the mug just in front of/below the spout and slowly nudged it in (at target from 528), released 585 at 0.011 m (0.013 m 2 s later), upright. The hold is long (156-585; successes release at 266-395), but the placement is excellent. Stage 1: 600-790 the gripper moved round to the right of the machine and onto the round button face; the machine registered on at 793. It then stayed at the button face, touching the machine on and off until the end (867-881, 927-1122, 1170-1200), never more than 25 cm from the mug. Stage 0's condition therefore never held (gripper too close), and neither did success.
causal_chain: slow but precise placement (release 585, 0.011 m) -> button pressed, machine on (793) -> gripper parks at the button face 800-1200 -> 'gripper > 0.15 m from button and > 0.25 m from mug' never met -> timeout
self_recovery: none; no withdrawal after the press.
official_criterion_notes: Packet says failed_stage 0 (stage 0 never complete) only because the gripper never got 25 cm from the mug; the mug was correctly placed from 528/585 to the end and the machine was on from 793. Physically both sub-goals were done.

packet_facts: holds: grasp 156 release 585 dist 0.0111 -> 0.013; at target 528-1200

uncertain_about: Whether the slow 156-585 hold reflects difficulty aligning under this machine's spout (the mug is just below the drip spout from ~320) - it did not cause the failure, there were 400 steps left after the press.
